bullets: Post-training: Own post-training for product-specific model behaviors and capabilities, from designing the experiments and building synthetic data pipelines and evaluation suites to fine-tuning the models.
Inference Optimization: Trained speculative-decoding draft models and optimized production serving for up to 2× faster generation.

org: Air Traffic Management Research Institute (ATMRI) · Nanyang Technological University
bullets: Safety-Critical Evaluation: Co-authored consequence-aware evaluation research for air traffic control (EMNLP 2026, IEEE ITSC 2026). Across eight models, standard metrics overstated reliability; risk-aware fine-tuning narrowed the gap.

ATC Assistant: Architected and built a multimodal RAG assistant for air traffic management, with ingestion of aviation documents and structured data, agentic graph-based multi-hop retrieval with evidence grounding, and an API for researchers.
User Research: Ran requirements and feedback sessions with air traffic controllers to shape the assistant's design.

LLM & VLM Post-training: Ran large-scale SFT and instruction tuning of KiLM, Zalo's Vietnamese LLM, raising its VMLU Vi-Dialog score from 44% to 84%. Built its vision-language version, which reached 43.8% on Vi-MTVQA (top score at release).

Human & Synthetic Data: Built data workflows for instruction tuning, including human-in-the-loop annotation with Vietnamese-specific guidelines and quality-control protocols, synthetic data generation, and iterative data refinement.
LLM Pre-training: Directed data-centric pre-training of KiLM from scratch, curating nearly 7 TB of cleaned text.

Multimodal Image Retrieval: Led Zalo Image Search, multimodal image retrieval in Vietnam's most-used messaging app, used by millions of users, covering model training, vector search and low-latency serving.

org: FPT Software AI Center · FPT Corporation
bullets: Vietnamese Language Modeling: Co-developed ViDeBERTa (co-first author, Findings of EACL 2023), a Vietnamese encoder that surpassed the previous state of the art on several NLU tasks, with a base model under a quarter the size of PhoBERT-large.
